baseline: Shipping active document merged with an empty inactive difference, at the corrected viewport. Calibration plus validation baseline is descriptive only; tuning uses calibration rows exclusively.
startingCandidate: Restart from active body/scatter/response parameters, zero outer-shadow and bright-rim terms, achromatic tint with retained collapse shade. Initial light shade endpoints 0.03/0.8 and dark 0.02/1.4 are a starting hypothesis, not adopted values. The prior attempt's fitted body/scatter parameters are not reused as an endpoint.
objective: Equal-cell mean per-pixel full-canvas OKLab distance, with eroded 6-CSS-px body mean linear Rec.709 Y and population SD. Report every profile and scale separately. Read actual spatial profiles before fitting width or heavy share.
sets: Fit 62 eligible calibration cells; check 16 validation cells. Exclude the 2x dark photo capsule rest pair. Do not read 12 recorded copies. Freeze a new declaration before the single 30-cell holdout read.
acceptance: Every profile calibration+validation mean improves over corrected active baseline. Bright rim and outer shadow disappear on standard/reduced-transparency; retain and measure increased-contrast outline. Report the checker capsule/checker rrect/photo rrect SD triple separately at 1x and 2x. Preserve active resolved SHA pins and renderer goldens.
holdout: UNREAD at this declaration; no fit adjustment may follow its one frozen read.
